versions.content: Invalid target identification block data If the Dcm fails to match the target identification block data from DcmModeConditionConnectionCertificateCom- pareElementRef as valid (e.g. number of required bytes do not match), the Dcm shall send a negative response with NRC 'Certificate verification failed - Invalid Format'.
